mas.hjem.forslag.ingen: No open suggestions. Events from your calendar are suggested as time entries here.
mas.sporing.titel: Automatic tracking is in the full version
mas.sporing.tekst: This App Store version has the timer, calendar and manual time. Automatic tracking of apps, windows and browser tabs needs access that apps from the App Store can't get. If you want it, you can download the full version of {brand} from {site}.
mas.sporing.kort: Automatic tracking is only in the full version from {site}
mas.opdateringer.titel: Updates come from the App Store
mas.opdateringer.tekst: The App Store keeps {brand} up to date. The full version from {site} updates itself.
mas.ai.ollama: From the App Store, {brand} can't start Ollama. Start it yourself, and the app will find it.
mas.licens.personlig_tekst: If you use {brand} for a business, you need the business licence. It is a one-time purchase in the App Store and covers all your Macs on the same Apple Account.
mas.licens.erhverv_tekst: The business licence was bought in the App Store and covers all your Macs on the same Apple Account. Thank you!
mas.licens.koeb_henter: Getting the price from the App Store …
mas.licens.ingen_produkt: The business licence can't be loaded from the App Store right now. Check your connection and try again.
mas.licens.venter: The purchase is waiting for approval, for example by your Family Sharing organiser. The licence turns on by itself once it is approved.
mas.licens.afbrudt: The purchase was cancelled. You have not been charged.
mas.licens.fejl: The purchase didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
mas.licens.ikke_bekraeftet: The App Store couldn't verify the purchase, so the licence is not turned on. Try Restore Purchases in a moment.
mas.licens.koebt: Thank you for your purchase! The business licence is on.
mas.licens.gendannet: Your purchase is restored. The business licence is on.
mas.licens.intet_at_gendanne: There is no purchase of the business licence on this Apple Account.
mas.licens.gendan_fejl: Purchases couldn't be restored. Try again in a moment.
mas.licens.valg: No account. Your data stays on this computer. Free for personal use.
